تتعاهدين (form VI)
# تَتَعَاهَدِينَ (tataʕāhadīna) /ta.ta.ʕaː.ha.diː.na/: second-person feminine singular non-past active indicative of تَعَاهَدَ (taʕāhada)
# تُتَعَاهَدِينَ (tutaʕāhadīna) /tu.ta.ʕaː.ha.diː.na/: second-person feminine singular non-past passive indicative of تَعَاهَدَ (taʕāhada)
